component.name: PlayDrop
component.summary: Send files and share the clipboard with your phone

description.p: PlayDrop links your phone and this computer over your local network. It sends files in either direction without an account or a cloud service, and resumes interrupted transfers where they stopped, including folders with thousands of small files.

A small background service keeps the computer reachable while the window is closed. Devices pair once by comparing a short code, and every connection after that is encrypted and checked against the paired key.
PlayDrop is early software. The desktop service, the window and computer-to-computer transfers work today; the phone apps are still being built.
First desktop build: background service, tray, window and local file transfers.
